subject: trs
title: TRS.------INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-26 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's diagnostic: 'the dynamics of spectacle diversion information perception have come to permeate the total lining of western culture and are manifested in everything from progressionalism to creativity (e.g., the relationship between how given techniques are viewed with respect to what the music is of that technique).' TRS (transition) is crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics): the question is what transition produces when crossed with information-dynamics — under permeated spectacle conditions. INFO-DY sits at the upper-center with LANG-DY (language dynamics) on the upper-right. BIA (bi-aitional) and C-RH (composite research) form the upper-center cluster. SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) branches from the main line and carries INFO-FR, from whose line MT-INFO-DB rises. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branches from the BIA line and carries LANG-DY and LG-DY (logical dynamics); RE-ST (restructuralism) branches from the LG-DY line. RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branches from the main line near the subject. REL-TECH (relevant technology) anchors the lower-left. REL-TECH hangs from the RT-ALGN line, and SOC-PR with (c) prefix (the concept of social programs) hangs from the line of ROTP, which branches from REL-TECH. ROTP (responsibility of the position) anchors the lower-center.
